MASTER PROMPT - "WILD CAT" FUTURISTIC PROTOTYPE HYPERCAR

SUBJECT & OVERALL DESIGN:
A wide, low-slung, aggressive futuristic endurance prototype hypercar named "Wild Cat", inspired by Le Mans race cars. Perfect symmetrical straight-on front view, centered in frame, isolated on a seamless pure white studio background with a glossy, reflective white floor. Heavy battle-worn racing patina: dirty matte off-white paint, brown rust streaks, metallic scratches, grime, dust, and exposed industrial rivets. Racing livery accents in deep navy blue and maroon red across the hood, fenders, front splitter, and roof.

KEY FEATURE — RAZOR-SHARP FRONT NOSE (DO NOT ROUND):
The front center terminates downward into a razor-sharp, pointed V-shaped wedge, like a wild cat's claw or fang. Two sloped hood planes angle diagonally downward and converge at a crisp, acute, knife-edge central apex. The central ridge is a sharp, hard-edged crease highlighted by a deep navy blue center stripe bordered in maroon red, forming an aerodynamic 3D blade cutting through the air—never rounded, blunt, or softened.

FRONT FASCIA, LIGHTING & CABIN:
Two large, symmetrical hexagonal amber-orange headlights turned on, glowing brightly with an intricate honeycomb LED matrix pattern. Above each headlight, a vertical orange LED accent strip. Below, integrated into the lower carbon splitter, symmetrical horizontal orange LED bars. Deep matte-black aerodynamic air intakes flanking both sides of the sharp central nose. Dark smoked panoramic windshield with subtle studio reflections, revealing a shadowy cockpit interior with red-stitched racing seats and a single left-side steering wheel (no duplicate steering wheel).

SIDE FENDERS & LIVERY NUMBERING:
On both front fenders, the number "50" painted in weathered orange military stencil typography, large and crisp. Both "50" decals must appear in normal, forward-reading orientation—never mirrored or reversed—symmetrically positioned with matching scale and wear.

NEGATIVE CONSTRAINTS (STRICTLY AVOID):
No license plate, no grey rectangular mounts, no "ID 72" text, and no typography or badges on the lower center nose. Keep the lower center area completely clean, ending strictly in the sharp pointed V-wedge. Do not round or blunt the front tip.

CAMERA, LIGHTING & FORMAT:
Front-facing camera from a slightly elevated high angle, medium focal length, crisp depth of field. Soft, diffused pure white studio lighting with gentle contact shadows and a realistic, softly blurred reflection of the hypercar on the glossy white studio floor. Aspect ratio 3:4, centered composition with generous white negative space around the sides and top, uncropped.
